bullets: Added /byok effort command to set reasoning depth for bring-your-own-key connections and remember it across runs.
Changed reasoning depth caps for Muse Spark, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and Gemini 3.8 Flash to lower or hard-limit the maximum.
Onboarding role, intended use, and subscriptions questions now show answer choices in shuffled order each time.
Kept the hour and discount reservation on active owned Freebucks CLI sessions instead of routing through the first-tab path.
Distinguished caller-initiated aborts from server idle timeouts so cancellations report as user-cancelled, not idle.
Resolved the shared usage quota pool by majority vote across models instead of picking whichever the server serialized first.
Matched quoted BYOK model IDs in provider rejection messages so valid errors are no longer missed.
Named the unset or rejected environment variable in BYOK credential errors instead of a generic message.
Rejoined paste-split line breaks in /byok commands and rejected extra arguments instead of silently dropping them.
Reported HTTP status and the provider model listing in /byok endpoint checks, naming available model IDs when yours is absent.
Kept Up/Down paging history from a recalled entry that has not been edited yet.
Added a server-side model catalog that overrides the compiled picker for session price, effort, limits, and context windows.
Moved the Freebuff auth token to the OS keychain via Bun.secrets, falling back to the existing file on headless or locked systems.
Reported country verification status and plan upsell fields in session admission responses.
Reported proxy, TLS, and timezone settings in the client environment descriptor sent with session requests.
Made the OpenAI-compatible tool call delta index optional so stream-dropped indices no longer fail parsing.
Let the assistant stop on spent daily limits instead of silently switching to a fallback model.
Allowed /byok endpoint checks to read the provider model list and confirm the configured model is available.
Tracked per-prompt input profile and terminal environment telemetry for product insights.
